faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know before opening your first day in Movix.

who.a: Pharmaceutical wholesalers, specialised carriers and delivery depots that deliver medicines to pharmacies. The web app is for dispatch, the mobile app for drivers.

access.a: Create your account, then join your company with the invitation code an administrator gives you. If your company is not on Movix yet, contact us and we will set it up.

mobile.a: No. The driver app runs on an Android phone. Loading and delivery scans use the phone camera.

routing.q: How is the stop order computed?
routing.a: Movix computes the route and the estimated arrival times on its own servers, taking each pharmacy's delivery window into account. The order is only saved when you confirm it.

exports.a: Yes. Tours, orders and invoices can be exported to spreadsheet files at any time.

languages.a: The web app and the driver app are available in French and English. Each user picks their own language.
